assessments.description: One entry per comment id you were asked to assess. Do not invent ids.

comment_id.description: Exactly one of the PC-* ids given to you.

verdict.description: VALID: the concern is real in the current head commit. PARTIALLY_VALID: something real is there but the comment misstates it. INVALID: traced it, the concern does not hold. ALREADY_ADDRESSED: it was real and a later commit in this PR fixed it. NOT_A_CLAIM: praise, a question, an approval, or a preference with no assertion to check.

severity.description: If the comment is valid, how much it matters. "none" for INVALID, ALREADY_ADDRESSED, and NOT_A_CLAIM.

overlaps_finding.description: Your own finding id covering the same defect, or "" if none. This is how we tell which human comments the reviewers independently rediscovered.

reasoning.description: Why. For ALREADY_ADDRESSED, name the commit or the code that now handles it.

evidence.description: file:line references plus quoted code from the head commit. An assessment with no citation is not usable.

notes.description: Anything the format could not carry, e.g. a comment thread whose meaning depends on context you do not have.
